# Statistical Plan

## Statistical plan summary
- Primary unit: a strict Tier 0-1 structure-matched pair.
- Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for medians (2000 replicates, seed 42).
- Rank stability: top-k Jaccard, Kendall tau, Spearman rho.
- Stratification by crystal system, space group, chemical system, response amplitude.
- PMR = median paired-source Frobenius disagreement / mean in-source MAE.
